scope: Authored development evidence, not independent human validation. Later final installed receipts supersede these development attempts without deleting them.

adjustments.observed: The first cold/warm comparisons exposed lost PDF table metadata after deepcopy because its integer keys were row object identities.
adjustments.change: Rebind Word/PDF/Markdown table metadata to copied row identities and compare complete reports, including exact positions.

adjustments.observed: Markdown parser objects retained callbacks and unsupported native state, so they bypassed bounded caching.
adjustments.change: Release parser callbacks and state after the read model is complete. Preserve static checking semantics and verify cold/warm reports.

adjustments.observed: Two initial tests incorrectly treated a figure as zero confirmed coverage after deleting occurrences and selected cache limits too small to exercise eviction.
adjustments.change: Check the occurrence group directly and use a fitting small cache plus a separate oversized input case.

adjustments.observed: The first portable-evidence cache test used a .json filename rejected by the existing export contract.
adjustments.change: Use .pdevidence.json for both initial and updated export fixtures, preserving integrity validation.

adjustments.observed: Final memory review found parsed evidence retained both raw byte/text buffers and its read model, and typed PDF-region objects have additional Pydantic slot containers.
adjustments.change: Drop no-longer-needed raw buffers after successful source parsing, account for hidden typed-model containers, rebuild the wheel and repeat final installed acceptance.

adjustments.observed: Two source aliases could read different snapshots of the same file during one check while the last alias overwrote its recorded hash.
adjustments.change: Reject inconsistent repeated source-path hashes as INPUT_CHANGED in both full and cached checks; retain separate race regressions.

adjustments.observed: One final-wheel platform run ended during the suite with process exit 1073807364 after 149.781 seconds. No completed JUnit or assertion failure was produced; the external termination cause is unverified.
adjustments.change: Preserve the failed receipt and rerun the same wheel in a new isolated environment. The completed run has 1010 passed tests and three POSIX-only Windows skips.

adjustments.observed: The first 1.8 remote browser run failed because the workflow harness treated any later review generation as proof that a CSV edit had been read. Delaying a real pre-edit response reproduces the early completion in all four bilingual cases.
adjustments.change: Wait for the exact changed CSV hash in a current review response, then its rendered generation. CI delays the genuine fragment-inclusive response and verifies that all three dependent workflow states become stale. No product response is fabricated or acceptance assertion removed.

adjustments.observed: The first diagnostic hash wait omitted the product sha256: prefix and timed out.
adjustments.change: Compare the documented complete identity string; retain the failed local diagnostic and the subsequent successful four-case run.

adjustments.observed: Strict PyPI rendering rejected the initial 1.9 heading underline. The initial package description also lacked the matching Chinese incremental paragraph.
adjustments.change: Fix the RST heading, add the Chinese paragraph and both guide links, rebuild the distribution and verify the final package. Runtime source/assets remain identical; archive metadata changes are recorded separately.

initial_baseline_note: The original benchmark records checkout file hashes as auxiliary metadata. baseline-1.8-runtime.json identifies the actual installed 1.8.0 wheel used for all baseline checks; no editable 1.9 code was loaded.
public_log_note: Public test log excerpts replace checkout paths and strip trailing whitespace; original local logs and JUnit files are retained under build. Frozen historical studies are unchanged.
